zones.label: Ireland
zones.description: Ireland occupies two blocks on the upper-left side of the chart. Both face the central performance area from that side of the arena.

zones.label: Russia
zones.description: Russia has two blocks along the upper middle edge of the arena, facing in toward the performance area.

zones.label: Norway
zones.description: Norway is the upper-right block between Russia and Spain on the supplied chart.

zones.label: Spain
zones.description: Spain bends around the upper-right corner of the arena, with one block along the top and one along the right side.

zones.label: Austria
zones.description: Austria wraps the lower-right corner, with blocks on the right and bottom edges of the arena.

zones.label: Hungary
zones.description: Hungary is the bottom-right block between Dragon and Austria on the supplied chart.

zones.label: Dragon
zones.description: Dragon has two blocks along the lower middle edge, facing toward the central performance area.

zones.label: France
zones.description: France occupies two blocks on the lower-left side of the arena, opposite Ireland on the chart.
